questions.prompt: The client wants to know why {property} is behind the rest of its metro. What are the engines saying instead?
rubric: Compares {property} with its metro using figures from the facts only.
Names written instead are described as named in the answer text, not cited.

questions.prompt: Give me the weakest properties in each metro, with numbers I can paste into the client update.
rubric: Groups properties only by the metros in the facts.
Keeps properties tied at the same rates as a tie, not a ranking.

questions.prompt: Which listing sites matter most for our non-branded visibility right now?
Quick one: what exactly does a sweep measure, and what is the difference between a mention and a citation?
rubric: Explains that a sweep asks each tracked question once per engine and records whether the answer text names the brand (mention) and whether its sources link the site (citation).
